description: Compares a taxable investment (option 1) against a tax-deductible vehicle such as a provident fund or life-insurance savings plan (option 2), matching the true out-of-pocket cost of both and applying entry/exit fees, AUM fees, commission and exit tax. Use to compare taxable investment with a tax-deductible investment vehicle. Require the annual contribution, the user's tax-relief rate and option 2's management fee. Reuse supplied facts and ask only for missing essentials. Disclosed forecast returns and optional omitted fee/tax inputs are modelling assumptions; do not invent personal contribution amounts.

netInvestment.description: Annual GROSS contribution into option 2, EUR. Option 1 receives the equivalent out-of-pocket amount.

opt1AnnualReturn.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default.

opt1EntryFee.description: One-off entry fee on option 1, EUR.

opt1ExitFee.description: One-off exit fee on option 1, EUR.

opt1ExitTax.description: Tax on option 1 gains at exit, percent.

opt1MonthlyFee.description: Fixed monthly fee on option 1, EUR.

opt2AdditionalFee.description: Additional annual fee on option 2, percent.

opt2AnnualReturn.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default.

opt2AumFee.description: Annual management fee on option 2, percent.

opt2Commission.description: Percent of the FIRST year's contributions taken as commission.

opt2ExitTax.description: Tax on option 2 at exit, percent.

opt2MonthlyFee.description: Fixed monthly fee on option 2, EUR.

taxDeductionRate.description: User's marginal tax relief on option 2 contributions, percent.

name: compare_investment_vehicles
